summary.text: Mark Enget is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 2 (home city listed as Powers Lake), serving since 2025 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Enget lists an occupation of Retired.
It lists education as University Studies, Criminal Justice, Secondary Education.
It also lists Gideons International, Lions Club and Bethel Baptist Church.
Family is listed as: Married (Roxanne); 3 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Enget's standing committee assignments as Energy and Natural Resources and Industry and Business.
